title: Add-ons kind: flow dir: right
[Admin] purple down addon: Addon | images, pinned by digest rev: AddonRevision | one per change [/] [It can add] teal down rt: Runtime | for Functions, Jobs ek: Kind with an engine | e.g. IdentityProvider engineless: Engineless kind | e.g. InfraStack settings: Settings kind | e.g. RauthyPasswordPolicy [/] [funcd runs or calls] blue down worker: Worker | its image engine: Engine | one per object fnr: Its Function | reconciles the objects fns: Settings Function | applies the settings [/]
addon > rev Admin > It can add rt > worker ek > engine engineless > fnr settings > fns
